description: Build facts of the hosted CI lanes (GitHub's ubuntu-24.04 runners, RFC 0027 L1): the distribution's GCC 13.3.0 and the linux-gcc provider, one dev flavor, the waf-engine stage. The desktop fragment pins the developer host's GCC 16; these lanes record the runner's compiler instead. Clang lanes override toolchain and build.toolchain.
